verdict.rationale: Insomnia (part of Kong's toolset) supports exporting collections/design docs in plain text formats (JSON v4, YAML v5, OpenAPI) explicitly for version control, and Inso CLI is documented for automating tests 'using your existing Git workflows.' However, there's no explicit documentation of a native git-sync feature or workflow for directly storing/syncing collections as repo files (e.g., folder-based git sync), only manual export/import and CLI automation. Missing for 10: explicit native git-sync/folder-based storage feature, hands-on/independent confirmation of git workflow usage, and clearer mapping of Kong Gateway declarative config to 'collections' vs Insomnia-specific collections.
